outcome.statement: More mobile visitors who land on a public recipe page keep a recipe (save it into a Kitchen). Sprint 10 exit number: mobile LCP <= 2.5 s at Lighthouse slow-4G on /r/<slug>, /browse and / (2026-09-06 baseline 7.6 / 7.7 / 6.1 s; re-measured 2026-09-29 after v0.5.x: 3.1 / 3.1 / 1.2 s). Second tier (Search Console, leading): non-brand impressions >= 100 per 28 days (baseline 6 non-brand of 18 total, 2026-09-01..09-28) and the tag hubs + /about indexed per URL Inspection. Sprint 10 is the launch sprint: the launch post ships last, gated on KAN-268 fixed, RUM instrumentation live >= 7 days, the KAN-181 invariants re-walked on production, and the UI-consistency lane done. North Star: recipes kept per week.
outcome.metric: recipes kept per week (North Star; inputs: recipe-page reach, view->save, generation+image completion, returning Kitchen use, publication); Sprint 10 gate: mobile LCP <= 2.5 s on the three public surfaces; second tier: GSC non-brand impressions >= 100/28d; launch readout pre-registered, measured 7 days after the launch post

tests.assumption: Real anchors are crawlable and open-in-new-tab works

opportunities.statement: Recipe images take 5+ seconds to appear on a throttled connection and pages look broken while they load; every image is a 0.9-1.8 MB full-resolution PNG/JPEG with no variants, no dimensions, and the SSR hero (the LCP element) is lazy-loaded
opportunities.evidence: Lighthouse 2026-09-06: LCP 7.6 s /r/<slug>, 7.7 s /browse; curl Content-Length on 7 images; recipe.html:38 loading=lazy on hero

solutions.statement: Resized image variants (thumb/card/hero, WebP) generated at upload or on first request and served with width/height, srcset/sizes, fetchpriority=high on the hero, lazy only below the fold

tests.assumption: LCP <= 2.5 s on /r/<slug> and /browse at slow-4G; above-the-fold image bytes <= 150 KB
tests.type: Lighthouse + network-requests audit

tests.assumption: Variants are cache-busted correctly by the existing ?v= hash and the 24 h Cache-Control
tests.type: curl headers before/after regenerate

solutions.statement: Low-quality placeholder (blurred tiny variant or dominant-colour box) painted in the fixed 4:3 container until the real image arrives

tests.assumption: CLS stays 0 and the placeholder paints before 1 s at slow-4G
tests.type: Lighthouse CLS + filmstrip

solutions.statement: Interim: Express-side resizing proxy over the existing PNGs (sharp), so the LCP number lands before the full variant pipeline

tests.assumption: Proxy resize p95 < 300 ms and Cloud Run memory stays under the 1 Gi limit
tests.type: Datadog express-frontend latency + Cloud Run memory metric

children.statement: The origin itself adds up to 9 s to an image request whenever the Flask Valkey client's IAM token has expired (33-37 min tokens, fixed 45 min refresh)
children.evidence: KAN-268 / RCP-98: Datadog 51% redis.command errors, image endpoint p95 9.6-11 s; Cloud Logging timeline

solutions.statement: Expiry-aware token refresh plus refresh-and-retry-once on AuthenticationError, and no redis-py retry on a dead credential (KAN-268)

tests.assumption: redis.command error rate < 1% and in-request redis.command GET p95 < 50 ms over 24 h in prod (AC 2 amended 2026-10-01, Adam option B); image endpoint p95 < 2 s
tests.type: Datadog APM aggregate, production

solutions.statement: Alternative: drop the Valkey read-through on the image path and rely on Cloud CDN / Cache-Control alone

tests.assumption: Image p95 < 2 s without the cache layer
tests.type: Datadog APM aggregate after a flag flip on staging preview

opportunities.status: partly shipped: sized variants and an eager hero in v0.5.0 (KAN-271); LCP 3.1 s on /r and /browse remains, KAN-268 (origin auth stalls) is the named blocker

tests.assumption: Filtered/sorted browse pages return 200, are cached, and do not create duplicate-content indexing (canonical or noindex on filtered views)

opportunities.statement: Identical and near-duplicate public pages split whatever ranking signal the catalog earns
opportunities.evidence: SEO audit 2026-09-13 C2 (KAN-275): two '-2' slugs statistically identical to their originals, a '-2' pizza dough with no original, three cornbreads, several near-pairs; recurrence of KAN-157

solutions.statement: Unpublish the identical '-2' copies (done by Adam, 2026-09-29) and curate competing recipes by hand; slug suffixing is unchanged: two authors' distinct recipes whose slugs collide still get '-2', including against a slug retired to the KAN-288 tombstone table; the cornbread canonical and joke-title naming are Adam decision rows, not work items

tests.assumption: The public catalog has no statistically identical pair after the change
tests.type: sitemap sweep comparing ingredient, step and word counts per slug pair

tests.assumption: A different author's distinct recipe whose slug collides still publishes as '-2'
tests.type: Backend API test: publishing a distinct same-title recipe succeeds with a '-2' slug

tests.assumption: A slug retired to the tombstone table on delete is never reissued; the next colliding publish gets '-2'
tests.type: Backend API test: delete a published recipe, publish a same-title recipe, assert a '-2' slug and the tombstoned slug still answers as retired

solutions.statement: Keep the copies published but emit rel=canonical to the original and drop them from the sitemap, so saved-copy owners keep their public page

tests.assumption: Google honours the declared canonical for the copies rather than choosing its own
tests.type: gsc_inspect_url on each copy: Google-selected canonical equals the original
